questions.question: What is the Disarming Charm Harry uses so often that other wizards know it is his?
questions.note: It knocks the wand out of an opponent's hand. During the seven Potters chase, the Death Eaters are told to watch for it.

questions.question: What do you shout to cast a Patronus?
questions.note: Lupin teaches it to Harry. A happy memory fuels it. It is the spell that drives Dementors off.

questions.question: What levitation charm does Professor Flitwick say is pronounced levi-O-sa?
questions.note: Hermione gets it on the first try. She later uses it to drop a club on the mountain troll.

questions.question: What charm unlocks a door?
questions.note: Hermione uses it on the third-floor door in the first film, and finds Fluffy on the other side.

questions.question: What charm lights the tip of a wand?
questions.note: Nox puts the light out. Harry uses Lumos in the shack, the forest, and under the trapdoor.

questions.question: What is the incantation of the Killing Curse?
questions.note: One of the three Unforgivable Curses. A shield charm will not block it. It is the curse that killed Harry's parents.

questions.question: What is the incantation of the curse that causes extreme pain?
questions.note: The Cruciatus Curse, also Unforgivable. Moody demonstrates it on a spider. Bellatrix used it on Neville's parents.

questions.question: What is the incantation of the curse that lets you control someone?
questions.note: The Imperius Curse. Fake Moody puts it on a spider, then offers to put it on a student. Many Death Eaters later claim they were under it.

questions.question: What charm summons an object to the caster?
questions.note: Harry uses it to call his broom in the first task. You name the thing you want after the spell.

questions.question: What spell stuns a person?
questions.note: A jet of red light. The D.A. practices it, and it is all over the Battle of Hogwarts.
